title.zh-TW: ultrareview 嚴格檢查工作區信任，未獲授權立即中斷
title.en: ultrareview Enforces Workspace Trust Checks, Halting Immediately Without Authorization

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機使用 `claude ultrareview` 進行進階程式碼審查時，工具現在會主動確認目前工作區是否值得信任。在一般終端機下它會跳出確認提問，若沒有互動終端或在自動化環境則會直接拒絕執行。在自動化腳本中，你必須加入不帶參數的 `--trust-workspace` 旗標（需放在 PR 編號或基準分支後面）。或者設定環境變數（執行時讀取的設定值）`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`。⟦好比大樓警衛室只讓登記過的訪客上樓，以前審查員可能直接走進私人辦公室，現在必須先刷卡確認訪客名單，未登記者一律在門外擋下。⟧當你在持續整合伺服器上排程跑深度審查，卻發現指令中斷時，可按上述位置補上信任旗標，通過工作區信任檢查。
body.en: When you run advanced code reviews in the terminal using `claude ultrareview`, the tool now actively verifies whether the current workspace is trusted. In a standard terminal, it prompts for confirmation, but it directly refuses execution if there is no interactive terminal or inside an automated environment. In automated scripts, you must include the `--trust-workspace` flag with no arguments (placed after the PR number or base branch). Alternatively, you can set the environment variable (configuration values read at runtime) `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`. ⟦Picture a building security desk that only allows registered visitors upstairs: where reviewers could previously walk straight into private offices, they must now badge in against the visitor log, and anyone unlisted is stopped at the door.⟧ When a scheduled in-depth review on a continuous integration server stops unexpectedly, add the trust flag in the position described above to pass the workspace trust check.

items.original: Changed `claude ultrareview` to require workspace trust: it asks on a terminal, else refuses; scripts pass `--trust-workspace`, which takes no value (put a PR number or base branch before it), or set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`

title.zh-TW: /claude-api 技能換裝多代理人架構，預設啟用動態工作流程
title.en: /claude-api Skill Adopts Multi-Agent Architecture, Enabling Dynamic Workflows by Default

body.zh-TW: 當你透過 `/claude-api` 技能規劃雲端代理人團隊時，背後生成團隊的底層範本已經升級。以往工具會採用舊有的協調員架構（coordinator）。現在改以 `multiagent_20261001` 架構建立 Managed Agents（由平台託管的代理人）子團隊，並預設開啟動態工作流程。⟦宛如專案工作室調整團隊編制，以前沿用舊的組織方式，現在改用新的團隊組織方式。⟧當你需要為多步驟任務設計多個助理分工時，直接呼叫 `/claude-api`，產出的代理人團隊就會採用這套架構，動態工作流程也已預設開啟。
body.en: When you design cloud agent teams through the `/claude-api` skill, the underlying template generating those teams has been upgraded. Previously, the tool relied on the legacy coordinator architecture. It now builds Managed Agents (agents hosted by the platform) subteams using the `multiagent_20261001` architecture, with dynamic workflows enabled by default. ⟦A project studio reorganizes its staffing: where it previously relied on an older organizational setup, it now adopts a new team structure.⟧ When you need to delegate multi-step tasks across multiple assistants, call `/claude-api` directly, and the generated agent team will use this architecture with dynamic workflows turned on by default.

items.original: Changed the `/claude-api` skill to build Managed Agents subagent teams on `multiagent_20261001` with dynamic workflows on by default, instead of `coordinator`

title.zh-TW: sed -i 採用標準指令確認，修改內容不再交由 /rewind 復原
title.en: sed -i Adopts Standard Command Prompts, Leaving Edits Outside /rewind Restoration

body.zh-TW: 在對話中要求 Claude 直接批次替換檔案文字時，`sed -i` 指令的執行與確認流程有了調整。以前這類就地修改指令會跳出模擬的檔案編輯預覽，現在它改為顯示標準的 Bash 執行提示，並依照輸入的原文直接運行。與其他透過 Bash 進行的修改一樣，執行過後的檔案變更不會再被 `/rewind` 指令復原。⟦跟在便條紙上動筆塗改一樣，以前動筆前會先在旁邊墊一張描圖紙給你看預覽，現在直接按指令在紙上落筆。⟧如果你打算在大量程式碼中批次取代變數名稱，執行前請確認修改內容，因為 `/rewind` 不會復原這類修改。
body.en: When you ask Claude to batch-replace file text in a conversation, the execution and confirmation flow for the `sed -i` command has been adjusted. Previously, this in-place modification command displayed a simulated file edit preview. It now displays a standard Bash execution prompt and runs directly with the verbatim input. Like other modifications made through Bash, resulting file changes will no longer be restored by the `/rewind` command. ⟦Think of writing corrections on a notepad: where you once placed tracing paper over the page to preview changes, you now put pen directly to paper as instructed.⟧ If you plan to batch-replace variable names across extensive code, verify your changes before running, because `/rewind` will not undo these modifications.

items.original: Changed `sed -i` to get the standard Bash prompt and run as written, not a simulated file-edit preview; like other Bash edits, it is no longer restored by `/rewind`

title.zh-TW: 補強沙盒隔離防線，嚴格限制設定檔與捷徑路徑寫入
title.en: Sandbox Isolation Hardened with Stricter Write Limits on Configs and Symlinks

body.zh-TW: 當你在 macOS 與 Linux 上啟用沙盒執行指令時，多項環境隔離與檔案寫入的防護邊界獲得了修正。沙盒內的 Bash 指令以前會在執行前於沙盒外載入 Shell 啟動檔，現在不會在隔離環境外偷跑。當目錄透過符號連結（指向真實位置的捷徑檔）連接時，macOS 的 `denyWrite` 規則現在會確實比對目標的真實位置，設定檔儲存庫的防寫限制也不會被捷徑繞過。沙盒指令與自動核准的修改不再能更動由 `--mcp-config` 指定的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）設定檔。在 Linux 環境中，背景指令即使存活超過原本的工作階段，沙盒禁止寫入的防線也不再提早解除。若沙盒處於啟用但無法運作的狀態，排除於沙盒外的指令在寫入允許清單的路徑前會主動跳出確認，並直接拒絕未隔離的備援操作。
body.en: When you enable sandboxing to run commands on macOS and Linux, several protection boundaries for environment isolation and file writes have been fixed. Bash commands inside the sandbox previously loaded Shell startup files outside the sandbox before execution. They no longer run outside the isolated environment. When directories are connected via symlinks (shortcut files pointing to real locations), macOS `denyWrite` rules now accurately match the real target location, preventing shortcuts from bypassing write restrictions on configuration repositories. Sandboxed commands and auto-approved modifications can no longer alter MCP (Model Context Protocol, enabling AI to connect with external tools) configuration files specified by `--mcp-config`. In Linux environments, even if background commands outlive their original session, write-prohibition boundaries in the sandbox are no longer lifted prematurely. If the sandbox is enabled but non-functional, commands exempted from the sandbox will prompt for confirmation before writing to allowlisted paths, while un-isolated fallback operations are rejected outright.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command
Fixed macOS sandbox `denyWrite` glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink
Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with `--mcp-config`
Fixed profile store write protection not applying when the config directory is reached through a symlink
Linux: Fixed sandbox write denies lifting when a background command outlived the session
Changed commands the settings exclude from the sandbox to ask before writing to its write-list paths while the sandbox is enabled but cannot run; the unsandboxed fallback is refused there

title.zh-TW: 終端機強化指令審核，嚴防重導向與目錄切換繞過授權
title.en: Terminal Strengthens Command Auditing, Blocking Redirection and Directory Changes Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 在終端機執行複合指令或刪除檔案時，幾處曾會漏掉權限提示或錯誤信任狀態的盲點已全數修復。Bash 權限檢查以前會盲目信任由指令設定的變數，即使該指令的輸出重導向根本無法開啟；現在不會再誤判為成功。當指令在執行 git 前先變更目錄，若 `cd` 被包裝或帶有前綴，Bash 檢查現在會像一般 `cd` 一樣確實跳出確認提示。當複合指令包含子 Shell 時，`Edit(path)` 阻擋規則現在能確實攔截指向該路徑的重導向寫入。在 Windows 上，若 `Set-Location` 或 `cd` 目標為當前目錄但帶有額外參數，PowerShell 權限檢查不再自動放行，而是會跳出核准詢問。桌面應用程式與 VS Code 在略過權限模式下若遇到危險的 `rm` 與 `rmdir` 指令，現在會直接拒絕並附上改寫建議，避免無人值守的工作階段卡在確認畫面。
body.en: When Claude runs compound commands or deletes files in the terminal, several blind spots that previously missed permission prompts or falsely trusted state have been fixed. Bash permission checks previously blindly trusted variables set by a command even if output redirection failed to open. They no longer misjudge such executions as successful. When a command changes directories before running git, Bash checks now properly prompt for confirmation if `cd` is wrapped or prefixed, matching standard `cd` behavior. When compound commands contain subshells, `Edit(path)` blocking rules now reliably intercept redirection writes targeting that path. On Windows, if `Set-Location` or `cd` targets the current directory with extra arguments, PowerShell permission checks no longer auto-approve the command, prompting for confirmation instead. When dangerous `rm` and `rmdir` commands run in bypass permissions mode, the desktop app and VS Code now reject them directly with rewrite suggestions, preventing unattended sessions from stalling on confirmation prompts.

items.original:
Fixed the Bash permission check trusting a variable set by a command whose redirect can fail to open
Fixed Bash permission checks not prompting for some compound commands that change directory before running git when the `cd` is wrapped or prefixed, as they do for a plain `cd`
Fixed an `Edit(path)` deny rule not blocking a Bash redirect to that path in some commands that also held a subshell
Windows: Fixed PowerShell permission checks auto-approving some `Set-Location` or `cd` commands that target the current directory and carry extra arguments; these now prompt for approval
Changed the dangerous `rm` and `rmdir` prompt in bypass permissions mode in the Desktop app and VS Code to deny the command at once with a rewrite hint, so unattended sessions keep going

title.zh-TW: 收緊工作樹隔離防護，Git 操作提速並預先載入物件
title.en: Worktree Isolation Guard Tightened, Accelerating Git Operations and Pre-fetching Objects

body.zh-TW: 當你啟用隔離環境讓多個對話平行處理不同任務時，版本控制與工作目錄的邊界防護有了重要改善。工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）隔離的工作階段中，先前部分帶有語系前綴、原本應被隔離守衛拒絕的指令會被放行，現在已修正；zsh 下原本會漏網的算術運算指令也會被阻擋。由 Claude Code 建立的工作樹與分支簽出，現在會像其他 Git 操作一樣主動忽略替換參照（replace refs）。Windows 上多項內部 Git 指令變快；在所有平台上，這些指令的錯誤訊息都改以英文顯示，不受 Git 語言設定影響。在一般複製品或設定了 Bash 沙盒的部分複製品中，建立與重複使用工作樹時不再隨選抓取物件；這類部分複製品會先抓取物件，再建立或重複使用工作樹。
body.en: When you enable isolated environments so multiple conversations can handle different tasks in parallel, boundary protections for version control and working directories have improved significantly. Inside sessions isolated by worktrees (Git features that maintain parallel copies of the same project), commands with locale prefixes that should have been rejected by the isolation guard previously slipped through, but this is now fixed. Arithmetic commands under zsh that previously went unnoticed are also blocked. Worktrees and branch checkouts created by Claude Code now actively ignore replace references, matching other Git operations. Multiple internal Git commands are faster on Windows. Across all platforms, error messages from these commands are now displayed in English, regardless of Git locale settings. In standard clones or partial clones configured with Bash sandboxing, creating and reusing worktrees no longer fetches objects on demand. Such partial clones now pre-fetch objects before creating or reusing a worktree.

Improved the speed of many git commands Claude Code runs for itself on Windows; on every platform, errors from those commands now show in English even when git is set to another language

title.zh-TW: /claude-api 擴充雲端追蹤支援，查核即時文件並開放授權令牌
title.en: /claude-api Expands Cloud Tracing Support, Verifying Live Docs and Enabling Auth Tokens

body.zh-TW: 當你請 `/claude-api` 技能協助配置雲端服務與鏈路追蹤時，多項說明準確度與追蹤設定已獲得改善。技能說明不再誤稱 `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` 會傳遞追蹤上下文。修正 C# 追蹤配置遺漏雲端平台客戶端跨度（spans）的瑕疵。修正原本聲稱 AWS 上的 Claude Platform 請求跨度無法加入呼叫端追蹤的錯誤說法。要求加入 OpenTelemetry 時，技能現在會在 SDK 追蹤之外同時主動提供 API 追蹤選項。技能在回覆功能不受支援前，會先連線查核最新即時官方文件。服務帳號金鑰與工作負載身分同盟的授權令牌（用來驗證身分的數位令牌），現在已可用於管理 OpenTelemetry 的輸出目的地。
body.en: When you ask the `/claude-api` skill to configure cloud services and distributed tracing, several documentation accuracies and tracing settings have been improved. The skill description no longer mistakenly claims that `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` propagates trace context. It fixes an issue in C# tracing setups where cloud platform client spans were omitted. It corrects the inaccurate claim that Claude Platform request spans on AWS cannot join caller traces. When asked to add OpenTelemetry, the skill now proactively provides API tracing options alongside SDK tracing. Before responding that a feature is unsupported, the skill now connects online to verify against current official documentation. Service account keys and authorization tokens (digital credentials used for identity verification) from workload identity federation can now be used to manage OpenTelemetry export destinations.

items.original:
Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` passes trace context to the command
Fixed the /claude-api skill's C# tracing setup missing spans from the cloud platform clients
Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that API spans for requests to Claude Platform on AWS can't join the caller's trace
Improved the /claude-api skill to offer API tracing alongside SDK tracing when asked to add OpenTelemetry
Improved the /claude-api skill to check the live docs before saying a feature is unsupported
Updated the /claude-api skill: service account keys and Workload Identity Federation tokens can now manage OpenTelemetry destinations

title.zh-TW: 技能命名支援目錄前綴區隔，資料圖表導入新版對比標準
title.en: Skill Names Support Directory Prefixes, Introducing Modern Contrast Standards to Dataviz

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案中載入多組外掛或自訂技能時，技能重複衝突與檔案讀取例外處理已得到修復。透過 `--add-dir` 載入的技能若與既有技能同名，以前會無法使用，現在會自動加上前綴顯示為 `<folder>:<name>`。在終端機 Shell 變更檔案後，`/verify` 與 `/code-review` 不再發生找不到巢狀套件自身技能的問題。從 claude.ai 同步的外掛與技能，在遭遇磁碟讀取錯誤時不會再於工作階段中途莫名被整組移除。內建的 dataviz 資料視覺化技能正式支援 APCA 文字對比度演算標準（在需要符合 AA 規範處仍維持 WCAG 2 比例），調色盤驗證腳本新增 `apca(text, background)` 函式，並能指引圖表著色區塊內的標籤該搭配白色或接近黑色。
body.en: When you load multiple plugins or custom skills into a project, duplicate skill collisions and file-read exception handling have been resolved. If a skill loaded via `--add-dir` shares the same name as an existing skill, it was previously unusable. It is now automatically prefixed as `<folder>:<name>`. After modifying files in the terminal Shell, `/verify` and `/code-review` no longer encounter issues locating skills belonging to nested packages. Plugins and skills synced from claude.ai are no longer removed entirely mid-session when encountering disk read errors. The built-in dataviz skill officially supports the APCA text contrast algorithm standard (while maintaining WCAG 2 ratios where AA compliance is required). Its palette verification script introduces the `apca(text, background)` function and guides whether labels inside shaded chart regions should pair with white or near-black.

items.original:
Fixed a skill in an `--add-dir` folder being unreachable when another skill already held its name; it is now offered as `<folder>:<name>`
Fixed `/verify` and `/code-review` not finding a nested package's own skill when its files were changed from the shell
Fixed plugins and skills synced from claude.ai being removed, sometimes mid-session, after a disk read error
Updated the bundled dataviz skill to accept APCA as a text-contrast measure (keeping WCAG 2 ratios where AA conformance is required), add an `apca(text, background)` function to its palette validator scripts, and say whether a label inside a colored chart fill should be white or near-black

title.zh-TW: 修正對話送出與檢視快捷鍵，工具預覽文字妥善處理表情符號
title.en: Shortcut Keys for Sending and Viewing Fixed, with Better Emoji Handling in Tool Previews

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機快速輸入文字與切換畫面時，快捷鍵的觸發反應與對話紀錄排版獲得了修正。以前在模型回覆開始前按下 ctrl+enter 立即送出，訊息只會進入排隊；若在提示詞掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）執行期間按下，還會重啟掛鉤並將訊息留在等待佇列，現在已徹底修正。在 `!` 開頭的 Shell 模式下，綁定快捷鍵的斜線指令不再錯誤地被丟進系統 Shell 中執行。按下 ctrl+o 時，來自其他代理人與工作階段中等待投遞的訊息，現在會完整標記為等待狀態並顯示在紀錄下方。工具輸出的長預覽文字若剛好截斷在表情符號中間，以往會導致工作階段紀錄損毀而無法被 `jq` 解析，現在已修正截斷處理。
body.en: When you quickly type text and switch views in the terminal, shortcut responsiveness and transcript formatting have been fixed. Previously, pressing ctrl+enter to send immediately before the model began responding merely queued the message. If pressed while prompt hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) were executing, it restarted the hook and left the message stranded in the queue, which is now resolved. In Shell mode prefixed with `!`, slash commands bound to shortcuts are no longer erroneously forwarded to the system Shell for execution. When pressing ctrl+o, pending messages awaiting delivery from other agents and sessions are now fully flagged as pending and displayed at the bottom of the log. If long preview text from tool output was truncated in the middle of an emoji, it previously corrupted the session transcript and prevented `jq` from parsing it, which has now been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed ctrl+enter (send now) only queuing a message when pressed before the response had started, and restarting a prompt's hooks while leaving the message queued when pressed while those hooks were running
Fixed key-bound slash commands running in the shell from `!` mode
Fixed ctrl+o not showing messages from other agents and sessions that are still waiting to be delivered; they now appear in full under the transcript, marked as waiting
Fixed long tool output previews being cut through an emoji, leaving session transcripts that `jq` could not parse

title.zh-TW: 隊友代理人繼承工具限制，自架執行器接軌中斷操作
title.en: Teammate Agents Inherit Tool Restrictions, Bridging Interrupted Operations on Self-Hosted Runners

body.zh-TW: 當你啟動分割視窗的隊友代理人或在自架伺服器上執行任務時，跨代理人設定傳遞與狀態銜接更為一致。分割視窗中的隊友代理人現在會確實繼承隊長在指令列指定的工具禁用規則與 `--tools` 限制。透過 `/rename` 重新命名的工作階段，在 VS Code 視窗重新載入或非互動式 `--resume` 恢復後，不會再以隨機產生的名稱顯示給其他對話。若該回合透過 `/code-review --fix`、子代理人或 Shell 指令修改了已納入檢查點的檔案，`/rewind` 清單不再誤顯示「沒有程式碼變更」。在自架執行器環境中，若首個提示詞仍在子代理人中運作，`--startup-timeout-min` 不會誤殺工作階段，但凍結的行程仍會被停止。當工作階段轉移到新的自架執行器時，Claude 現在能清楚看見被中斷的工具呼叫，並將其標記為結果未知。
body.en: When you launch split-pane teammate agents or run tasks on self-hosted servers, cross-agent configuration propagation and state transitions are more consistent. Teammate agents in split panes now properly inherit tool disablement rules and `--tools` restrictions specified on the command line by the lead agent. Sessions renamed via `/rename` no longer revert to randomly generated names when viewed from other conversations after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume`. If a turn modifies checkpointed files through `/code-review --fix`, subagents, or Shell commands, the `/rewind` list no longer erroneously displays 'no code changes'. In self-hosted runner environments, `--startup-timeout-min` will not terminate the session prematurely if the initial prompt is still active in a subagent, though frozen processes are still stopped. When a session transitions to a new self-hosted runner, Claude can now clearly see interrupted tool calls and mark them as having an unknown result.

items.original:
Fixed split-pane agent teammates not inheriting the tool deny and `--tools` rules given on the leader's command line
Fixed sessions renamed with `/rename` appearing to other sessions under a generated name after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume`
Fixed the `/rewind` list showing "No code changes" for a turn that changed checkpointed files through `/code-review --fix`, a subagent or a shell command
Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--startup-timeout-min` stopping a session whose first prompt, such as `/code-review`, was still working in a subagent; a frozen process is still stopped
Self-hosted runner: Improved sessions that move to a new runner: Claude now sees the tool call that was interrupted, marked as outcome unknown

title.zh-TW: 修復 PowerShell 掛鉤阻擋機制，別名模型自動解析
title.en: PowerShell Hook Blocking Fixed, Aliased Models Automatically Resolve

body.zh-TW: 當你在工作流程中設定自訂掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）以攔截工具或步驟時，Windows 與模組載入的相容性獲得了提升。在 PowerShell 中運行的掛鉤程式若以代碼 2 結束，以往無法成功阻擋操作，現在已能正確攔截。在未安裝 Git for Windows 的 Windows 環境中，指定使用 PowerShell 的工具前置與權限請求掛鉤也不再因缺少該工具而直接失守放行。自訂模組的 `turn.step` 掛鉤中若以別名（例如 `haiku`）指定模型，以前每次請求都會失敗，現在會正確解析出對應模型。當掛鉤模組因巢狀過深而無法載入時，錯誤訊息現在會明確點名出問題的檔案路徑，不再只印出簡略的堆疊溢位提示。
body.en: When configuring custom hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) in your workflow to intercept tools or steps, compatibility with Windows and module loading has improved. Hook programs running in PowerShell that exit with code 2 previously failed to block operations, but now intercept them correctly. On Windows environments where Git for Windows is not installed, pre-tool and permission-request hooks specifying PowerShell no longer fail open simply due to the missing tool. If a model is specified by an alias (such as `haiku`) in the `turn.step` hook of a custom module, requests that previously failed every time now correctly resolve the corresponding model. When a hook module fails to load due to excessive nesting, error messages now explicitly identify the problematic file path instead of printing a terse stack overflow notice.

items.original:
Fixed hooks that run in PowerShell not blocking when the hook's program exits with code 2, and on Windows `PreToolUse` and `PermissionRequest` hooks with `"shell": "powershell"` failing open when Git for Windows isn't installed
Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook that names a model by alias, such as `haiku`, failing every request with a model error: the alias now resolves to its model
Improved the error when a hooks module is nested too deep to load: it now names the file instead of showing a bare stack-overflow message

title.zh-TW: 大型說明檔避免重複壓縮，成品發布與權限不再頻繁卡關
title.en: Large Instruction Files Avoid Repeated Compaction, Artifact Publishing and Permissions No Longer Stall

body.zh-TW: 當對話中包含大量說明文件或正在發布網頁成品時，對話壓縮與成品更新流程不再反覆打擾。讀取受大型巢狀 `CLAUDE.md` 管轄的檔案後，工作階段以前會陷入反覆壓縮對話的循環；現在若巢狀說明檔超出容量上限，工具只會載入檔案開頭部分。發布或更新成品時，以往部分包含特定縮減程式碼（minified scripts）或未被預先讀取的常見頁面會遭到拒絕，現在已能正常發布。在同一個回合中，若對話曾觸發過內容壓縮，Claude 以前會在後續每次更新成品時不斷重複要求授權，這個問題現在已經修復。
body.en: When conversations involve extensive documentation or web artifacts are being published, conversation compaction and artifact update flows no longer cause repeated interruptions. After reading files governed by a large nested `CLAUDE.md`, sessions previously fell into loops of repeatedly compacting conversations. If a nested instructions file exceeds the size limit, the tool now loads only the initial portion of the file. When publishing or updating artifacts, certain common pages containing specific minified scripts or pages that were not preread previously faced rejection, but can now be published normally. If a conversation triggered content compaction within the same turn, Claude previously asked for permission repeatedly on every subsequent artifact update, an issue that is now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed sessions compacting repeatedly after reading files under a very large nested CLAUDE.md; a nested CLAUDE.md over the size limit now loads only its start
Fixed artifact publishes and updates being refused for some ordinary pages, such as pages with certain minified scripts or artifacts Claude could not read first
Fixed Claude asking for permission on each artifact update for the rest of a turn after the conversation was compacted in that turn

title.zh-TW: 桌面工作階段維持連線，遠端狀態列與停用工具不再錯亂
title.en: Desktop Sessions Stay Connected, Remote Status Line and Disabled Tools No Longer Misbehave

body.zh-TW: 當你透過桌面應用程式或遠端控制操作 Claude Code 時，帳號狀態與背景連線的穩定度得到了改善。在列印模式與 SDK 工作階段中，已經停用的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，以前會在後續跳出權限提示時被意外重新連線，現在已維持關閉。在由 Claude 桌面應用程式託管的工作階段中，網路連線重新整理時對話訊息偶爾遺失的問題已經排除。當同一台電腦上的終端機登入了不同帳號或組織時，桌面應用程式中的工作階段以前會遺失部分功能，現在不會再因此缺少功能。針對非 Git 儲存庫的普通資料夾，`claude remote-control` 的狀態列（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）不再將分支名稱錯誤顯示為 `HEAD`。
body.en: When operating Claude Code through the desktop app or remote control, the stability of account status and background connections has improved. In print mode and SDK sessions, disabled MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers previously reconnected unexpectedly when permission prompts appeared later, but now remain closed. In sessions hosted by the Claude desktop app, an issue where conversation messages were occasionally lost during network refreshes has been eliminated. When terminals on the same computer are logged into different accounts or organizations, sessions inside the desktop app previously lost certain features, but will no longer miss capabilities as a result. For standard folders that are not Git repositories, the status line (the bar displayed at the bottom of the terminal) of `claude remote-control` no longer mistakenly shows the branch name as `HEAD`.

items.original:
Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions
Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop-hosted session sometimes being lost when its connection refreshed
Fixed features missing from Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app when the terminal on the same computer was signed in to a different account or organization
Fixed the `claude remote-control` status line showing `HEAD` as the branch for a folder that is not in a git repository

title.zh-TW: 隱私設定即時同步，意見回饋與 GitHub 標記精確呈現
title.en: Privacy Settings Sync in Real Time, Feedback and GitHub Mentions Render Accurately

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機檢查隱私設定或向官方回報問題時，回傳的訊息說明與對外發布內容更加清晰。輸入 `/privacy-settings` 時，以前可能顯示過期的「協助改善我們的 AI 模型」開關狀態；現在會即時呈現最新設定，無法取得設定時也會明確告知。當你所屬的組織未開放意見回饋時，送出 `/feedback` 不再只顯示含糊的「請稍後再試」，而是會顯示伺服器提供的具體原因並指引回報錯誤的管道。含有大量紀錄的超大 `/feedback` 報告在傳送失敗時，現在會自動改為排除對話紀錄後重新送出，不再直接報錯中斷。在發布 Pull Request、議題或留言時，Claude 不會再將角色名稱或佔位符寫成 `@` 標籤，避免意外通知到無關的 GitHub 使用者。
body.en: When checking privacy settings in the terminal or reporting issues to the team, returned explanations and public content are much clearer. Running `/privacy-settings` previously might have displayed an outdated toggle state for helping improve AI models, but now displays current settings in real time and clearly states when settings cannot be retrieved. When feedback is not enabled for your organization, submitting `/feedback` no longer merely displays a vague request to try again later, instead presenting the specific reason provided by the server and directing you to bug-reporting channels. When an oversized `/feedback` report containing extensive logs fails to transmit, it now automatically retries after excluding conversation transcripts, rather than aborting directly with an error. When publishing pull requests, issues, or comments, Claude no longer formats role names or placeholders as `@` mentions, preventing unintended notifications to unrelated GitHub users.

items.original:
Fixed `/privacy-settings` showing an out-of-date "Help improve our AI models" value; it now also says when the setting can't be fetched
Fixed feedback saying "try again later" when your organization does not accept feedback; it now shows the server's reason and where to report a bug
Fixed oversized /feedback reports failing instead of being resent without the transcript
Fixed Claude notifying unrelated GitHub users by writing role names and placeholders as mentions in PRs, issues and comments

title.zh-TW: 磁碟空間滿載提供清理指引，修復串流逾時與工具安裝彈窗
title.en: Full Disk Space Provides Cleanup Guidance, Streaming Timeouts and Tool Installation Popups Fixed

body.zh-TW: 當底層系統空間不足或身處特定雲端環境時，錯誤提示與連線等待機制變得更為實用。在共用 `/proc` 的 Linux 沙盒中，讀取工具讀取特定 PDF 頁面範圍不再誤報檔案不存在。在 Amazon Bedrock 將 `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` 設為預設端點時，細粒度串流不會再被錯誤關閉。透過僅發送保持連線訊號（keepalive pings）的閘道連線時，等待 API 回覆提示不再閃爍，非 Anthropic 後端會等待 45 秒。在未安裝 Xcode，也未安裝 Command Line Tools（命令列開發工具）的 Mac 上，啟動 Claude Code 不再每次跳出安裝視窗。磁碟滿載導致 Bash 指令中斷時，會說明原因並點名應釋放空間的資料夾；暫存空間已滿時啟動也會顯示清楚訊息而非晦澀代碼。
body.en: When the underlying system is low on space or running in specific cloud environments, error prompts and connection waiting mechanisms are more practical. Inside Linux sandboxes sharing `/proc`, the read tool no longer falsely reports that files do not exist when reading specific PDF page ranges. When Amazon Bedrock configures `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` as the default endpoint, fine-grained streaming is no longer mistakenly disabled. When connecting through gateways that only send keepalive pings, the prompt waiting for API responses no longer flickers, and non-Anthropic backends wait for 45 seconds. On a Mac with neither Xcode nor Command Line Tools (developer tools for the command line) installed, launching Claude Code no longer triggers an installation popup every time. When Bash commands abort because the disk is full, the tool explains the reason and names the folder where space should be freed. Starting up when temporary storage is full also displays a clear message rather than cryptic codes.

items.original:
Fixed Read reporting "File does not exist" for PDF page ranges in Linux sandboxes that share the parent's `/proc`
Fixed fine-grained tool streaming staying off on Amazon Bedrock when `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` is set to the default `bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com` endpoint
Fixed the "Waiting for API response" hint flickering behind gateways that send only keepalive pings: routes off Anthropic's backend now wait 45 seconds
macOS: Fixed the "Install Command Line Developer Tools" dialog opening each time Claude Code starts on a Mac without Xcode or the Command Line Tools
Improved disk-full handling: a Bash command cut off by a full disk now says so and names the folder to free up, and starting on a full temp volume prints a clear message, not a raw ENOSPC error

title.zh-TW: VS Code 聊天面板長訊息支援摺疊，快取損壞自動修復
title.en: VS Code Chat Panel Supports Collapsing Long Messages, Corrupted Cache Automatically Recovers

body.zh-TW: 當你在 VS Code 側邊面板中使用 Claude Code 時，幾處版面繪製與快取異常已經獲得排除。當編輯器因快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）了不完整的檔案而導致 Claude 面板一片空白時，擴充套件現在會自行恢復，或明確提示問題原因與手動解決方法。像 `/goal` 這類過長的斜線指令提示詞，現在會像其他長訊息一樣自動摺疊在展開按鈕後方，即使把聊天面板調窄，長訊息也不會撐破版面。輸入框上方標示來自特定外掛的提示標籤，不再錯誤遮擋斜線指令與 `@` 標註的選單。貼上複製的 LaTeX 數學公式時，不再產生多餘的空白清單項目、空白段落或程式碼區塊，編號清單也不會再被強制從 1 重新起算。
body.en: When using Claude Code in the VS Code side panel, several layout rendering and caching anomalies have been resolved. When the editor caches an incomplete file and causes the Claude panel to go completely blank, the extension now recovers on its own or clearly explains the cause and manual resolution. Lengthy slash command prompts such as `/goal` now automatically collapse behind an expand button just like other long messages, and narrowing the chat panel will no longer cause long messages to break the layout. Hint tags above the input box indicating specific plugins no longer mistakenly obscure menus for slash commands or `@` mentions. Pasting copied LaTeX mathematical formulas no longer creates superfluous empty list items, blank paragraphs, or code blocks, and numbered lists are no longer forced to restart from 1.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the Claude panel staying blank after the editor cached an incomplete copy of its files; it now recovers by itself, or says what went wrong and how to fix it
[VSCode] Fixed long slash-command messages such as `/goal` filling the chat panel; they now fold behind Show more like other prompts (anthropics/claude-code#97469)
[VSCode] Fixed long messages not folding behind Show more after the chat panel is made narrower
[VSCode] Fixed a mod's "From the … plugin" label above the prompt being drawn over the slash command and @-mention menus (anthropics/claude-code#102981)
[VSCode] Fixed an empty list item, paragraph or code block, and list items renumbered from 1, when pasting copied LaTeX math

title.zh-TW: VS Code 編輯等待時間縮短，憑證警告提示與空紀錄修復
title.en: VS Code Edit Wait Time Shortened, Certificate Warning Guidance and Empty Logs Fixed

body.zh-TW: 當你在 VS Code 中編修程式碼或發出語音指令時，操作延遲與背景紀錄邏輯獲得了調整。聽寫或套件自身請求的憑證（確認連線對象身分的證明）驗證失敗時，例如經過會檢查加密流量的代理伺服器，日誌現在會提供處理指引。每次開啟新對話卻未發送訊息時，歷史紀錄不再被空工作階段塞滿。若在 `~/.claude/keybindings.json` 的 Chat 區段將 `"ctrl+j"` 設為 `null`，在聊天輸入框按下 Ctrl+J 不再強制換行，改交由 VS Code 與作業系統處理。當組織不接受意見回饋時，錯誤提示不再只回傳 HTTP 狀態碼，會顯示具體原因。聊天面板中的編輯與寫入速度加快，每次編輯後等待偵測新問題的時間從原本的 1 至 1.5 秒縮短為多數情況下的 0.75 秒。
body.en: When editing code or issuing voice commands in VS Code, operational latency and background logging logic have been adjusted. When certificate verification (checking digital proof of the connection target's identity) fails for dictation or extension requests, such as when passing through a proxy that inspects encrypted traffic, logs now provide troubleshooting guidance. Opening a new conversation without sending a message no longer clutters history with empty sessions. If `"ctrl+j"` is set to `null` in the Chat section of `~/.claude/keybindings.json`, pressing Ctrl+J in the chat input box no longer forces a newline, deferring handling to VS Code and the operating system. When an organization does not accept feedback, error prompts no longer return only an HTTP status code, displaying the specific reason instead. Editing and writing in the chat panel are faster, reducing the wait time to detect new problems after each edit from 1 to 1.5 seconds down to 0.75 seconds in most cases.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a log warning that says what to do when dictation or the extension's own requests fail certificate verification, such as behind a TLS-inspecting proxy
[VSCode] Fixed Session history filling up with empty "Untitled" sessions each time you start a new session without sending a message
[VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+J in the chat input always inserting a newline: it is now left to VS Code and the OS when "ctrl+j" is set to null in the Chat context of ~/.claude/keybindings.json
[VSCode] Fixed the feedback error showing only an HTTP status when your organization does not accept feedback
[VSCode] Improved Edit and Write speed in the chat panel: the wait for new problems after each edit is now 0.75 seconds in most cases, down from 1 to 1.5 seconds

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段修正環境變數引號，管理介面與變更清單明朗化
title.en: Cloud Sessions Fix Environment Variable Quotes, Admin Interface and Changes List Clarified

body.zh-TW: 當你在瀏覽器管理雲端工作階段與連線設定時，表單填寫與文件顯示體驗有了改善。在例行表單中新增連接器時，清單在載入期間不再誤報沒有可用的連接器。雲端環境編輯器不再打亂變數順序，當數值同時包含單引號與雙引號時，也不會再多餘地自動補上反斜線。管理設定中的自架環境對話框獲得調整，標題、分頁標籤與按鈕在滾動時會固定在可視範圍，只有中間內容會捲動。雲端工作階段中的閱讀文件工具列不再顯示跳脫後的 JSON 原始碼，而是會呈現易讀的排版內容。變更面板現在會主動標明目前是僅列出已推送的提交，還是僅顯示 Claude 的檔案修改。
body.en: When managing cloud sessions and connection settings in the browser, the experience for filling out forms and viewing documents has improved. When adding connectors in routine forms, the list no longer falsely claims that no connectors are available while loading. The cloud environment editor no longer scrambles variable order, nor does it insert redundant backslashes when values contain both single and double quotes. The self-hosted environment dialog in administrative settings has been adjusted so that headers, tabs, and buttons stay pinned in view while scrolling, leaving only the middle content scrollable. The document-reading toolbar in cloud sessions no longer displays escaped raw JSON, rendering cleanly formatted content instead. The changes panel now explicitly clarifies whether it is listing only pushed commits or displaying only file modifications made by Claude.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the Add connector list in routine forms saying no connectors were available while they were still loading
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the cloud environment editor shuffling environment variables and adding backslashes to values that contain both kinds of quote
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the self-hosted environment details dialog in admin settings so its title, tabs and buttons stay in view while only the content scrolls
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the "read documentation" tool row in cloud sessions, which showed escaped JSON instead of a readable page
[Cloud sessions] Improved a cloud session's Changes pane, which now says when it lists only pushed commits or only Claude's edits

title.zh-TW: Slack 標註草稿正確轉發頻道，審核按鈕支援重啟對話
title.en: Slack Channel Drafts Dispatch Correctly, Review Buttons Support Restarting Sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你的團隊在 Slack 頻道中使用 Claude 進行協作時，訊息派送與互動卡片的穩定性顯著提升。你在頻道中核准的草稿，以前可能被 Claude 誤貼到私訊中；現在沒有指明頻道的貼文會被直接拒絕，確保內容確實發布至指定的頻道。在審核卡片上按下核准或拒絕時，若背後的工作階段已經停止，你的操作現在會自動重啟該工作階段繼續執行。在工作區轉移至不同 Claude 組織後（包括 Enterprise Grid 上的未共用頻道），Claude 不會再漏看頻道中未被標註的討論訊息。在對討論串發布回覆之前，Claude 現在會先讀取其他人剛發送的最新留言，避免發言內容脫節。管理後台的 Slack 設定頁面若載入失敗，不再誤報尚未連接工作區，而是會顯示錯誤訊息並提供重試按鈕。
body.en: When your team collaborates with Claude inside Slack channels, the reliability of message dispatching and interactive cards has significantly improved. Drafts approved in a channel were previously at risk of being mistakenly posted by Claude into direct messages. Posts without a specified channel are now rejected outright, ensuring content is delivered to the designated channel. When clicking approve or reject on a review card, if the underlying session has stopped, your action now automatically restarts that session to proceed. After workspaces are migrated to a different Claude organization (including unshared channels on Enterprise Grid), Claude no longer misses unmentioned discussion messages in channels. Before posting replies to a thread, Claude now reads the latest comments just posted by others, preventing disjointed responses. If the admin Slack settings page fails to load, it no longer falsely reports that no workspace is connected, instead displaying an error message alongside a retry button.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack posting a draft you approved for a channel into your DM by mistake; a post with no channel is now refused so it can go to the approved channel
[Claude Tag] Fixed Allow and Deny on Claude's approval cards in Slack doing nothing when the session had stopped; your answer now restarts the session
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude ignoring untagged messages in a Slack channel after its workspace moved to a different Claude organization, including unshared channels on Enterprise Grid
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack channel posting a threaded reply before reading a newer message someone had just added to that thread
[Claude Tag] Fixed the Slack page in Claude Tag admin settings saying no workspaces were connected when the list failed to load; it now shows an error with a Retry button

title.zh-TW: PR 審查檢查標記自動補全，手動停止審查及時關閉檢查
title.en: Pull Request Review Check Marks Automatically Backfilled, Manual Stops Promptly Close Checks

body.zh-TW: 當你在 GitHub Pull Request 上等待自動程式碼審查時，檢查狀態更新結果現在更為準確。當審查已經順利完成，但先前建立檢查狀態的嘗試曾失敗過，工具在最終重試時現在會確實補上已完成的檢查標記，不再讓 PR 懸空呈現沒有檢查結果的狀態。若在審查執行期間推播了新的程式碼並在後方排隊，即使輸入了 `@claude review stop` 手動停止，以往排隊的審查仍會被啟動；現在排隊的檢查會立即關閉，並具體註明被停止的原因。⟦如同公文簽核系統在審批完畢後自動蓋上最終核准章，中途撤回的案件也會立刻標記撤回原因，避免審核進度懸而未決。⟧
body.en: When waiting for automated code reviews on GitHub pull requests, check status updates are now more accurate. When a review finishes successfully but earlier attempts to create the check status failed, the tool on its final retry now reliably backfills the completed check mark, preventing the pull request from hanging in a state with no check results. If new code is pushed during an ongoing review and queued up behind it, typing `@claude review stop` to halt the review manually previously still allowed queued reviews to start. Queued checks are now closed immediately with the specific cancellation reason noted. ⟦Just as an official document approval system automatically applies a final approval stamp once sign-off is complete, any case recalled midway is immediately marked with the withdrawal reason to prevent review progress from remaining in limbo.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed a finished review showing no check on the pull request when earlier tries to create it failed; a final try now adds a completed check
[Code Review] Fixed a push queued behind a running review still starting a review after `@claude review stop`; its check now closes and says why

title.zh-TW: /presets 新增十組快捷欄位，常用提示詞與指令隨選即用
title.en: /presets adds ten shortcut slots for instant access to frequent prompts and commands

body.zh-TW: 當你反覆在對話中輸入相同的檢查指令或固定提問時，重新打字往往耗費時間。⟦宛若汽車音響上的電台記憶功能，以前想聽固定頻道每次都要手動調頻，現在可以選取已儲存的頻道。⟧現在你可以打 `/presets` 將常用的提示詞與斜線指令儲存到十個編號欄位中。呼叫時還會跳出專屬的鍵盤選單，讓你透過鍵盤快速選取所需的預設項目。例如每次開始整理報告時，就能透過鍵盤選單選取儲存好的審查指令，省去反覆翻找與複製貼上的麻煩。
body.en: When you repeatedly enter the same inspection commands or standard questions during a conversation, retyping them is often time-consuming. ⟦Picture a car radio with station presets, where listening to a favorite channel once required manual tuning each time, but now only takes selecting a saved station.⟧ You can now type `/presets` to store frequently used prompts and slash commands into ten numbered slots. Invoking it brings up a dedicated keyboard menu so you can quickly choose the preset you need. For example, whenever you start compiling a report, you can select a saved review command through the keyboard menu, eliminating the hassle of searching around and copy-pasting.

items.original: Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)

title.zh-TW: /model 與 /permissions 支援行內參數，單行直接套用設定
title.en: /model and /permissions support inline arguments to apply settings in one command

body.zh-TW: 臨時需要切換模型或調整執行權限時，你可以把要用的設定直接接在指令後面。⟦如同在義式咖啡機直接轉動濃淡旋鈕，以前分開調整的出杯速度與風味濃度，現在點選飲品時順手一扭就能一併指定。⟧現在打 `/model` 或 `/permissions` 時，可以直接在同一行指令接上參數。你能直接在指令後方指定模型名稱、運算速度與推理解題力度（reasoning effort）。如果需要變更授權層級，也可以透過行內參數指定權限設定檔（permission profile）。這讓你輸入一行指令就能立刻切換到所需的執行環境。
body.en: When you need to switch models or adjust execution permissions on the fly, you can append your desired settings directly to the command. ⟦Think of turning a brew strength knob on an espresso machine, where cup speed and flavor intensity once had to be adjusted separately, but now can be set with a quick twist when selecting a beverage.⟧ When typing `/model` or `/permissions`, you can now pass arguments directly on the same line. You can specify the model name, compute speed, and reasoning effort right after the command. If you need to change authorization levels, you can also specify a permission profile through inline arguments. This lets you switch immediately to the required runtime environment with a single command.

items.original: Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)

title.zh-TW: 支援 Kitty 與 Sixel 協定，全螢幕紀錄直接預覽圖片
title.en: Kitty and Sixel protocols supported to preview images directly in fullscreen logs

body.zh-TW: 在純文字終端機中請 AI 產生或查看圖片時，常常必須切換到外部檢視器才能確認成果。⟦彷彿按下數位相機快門後直接在電子觀景窗回放相片，以前非得把記憶卡插進電腦螢幕才能檢視構圖，現在眼睛不用離開目鏡就能看清影像細節。⟧如果你的終端機支援 Kitty 或 Sixel 圖形協定，現在全螢幕對話紀錄中可以直接預覽圖片。無論是讓工具讀取既有的本機圖檔，或是由模型新產生的圖片，畫面都會直接在紀錄中渲染顯示，不必再特地跳出視窗開啟檔案。
body.en: When asking AI to generate or inspect images in a plain-text terminal, you often have to switch to an external viewer to verify results. ⟦Much like checking a digital camera's electronic viewfinder right after pressing the shutter, where reviewing composition once required plugging a memory card into a computer monitor, you can now inspect image details without taking your eye off the eyepiece.⟧ If your terminal supports the Kitty or Sixel graphics protocol, you can now preview images directly inside fullscreen conversation transcripts. Whether the tool reads an existing local image file or displays a new image generated by the model, the graphic renders directly within the log without opening an external window.

items.original: Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)

title.zh-TW: 企業級 MCP 支援專用登入與帳號授權，納入金鑰用戶端
title.en: Enterprise MCP supports dedicated login and account authorization with secret client access

body.zh-TW: 企業團隊在將內部系統串接至外部工具時，往往受限於嚴格的身分核驗與安全規範。⟦跟持員工證進入特約商務中心一樣，以前訪客通道只能辨識一般識別貼紙，現在閘門不僅支援企業總部的數位權限卡，也能核對附帶安全密鑰的專屬通行條。⟧現在企業級 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）連線支援更多元的驗證方式。你可以使用符合資格的 Codex 帳號授權直接通行，或是使用專屬登入通道完成驗證。對於需要用戶端密鑰（client secret）的 OAuth 用戶端，現在也能順利通過身分確認，安全連接各項企業服務。
body.en: When enterprise teams connect internal systems to external tools, they are often constrained by strict identity verification and security policies. ⟦Just as entering a partner business center with an employee badge once only supported basic visitor decals, the gate now accepts corporate digital access cards as well as dedicated passes with security keys.⟧ Enterprise MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) connections now support more diverse authentication methods. You can authenticate directly using eligible Codex account authorization or complete verification through dedicated login channels. OAuth clients requiring client secrets can now also pass identity verification smoothly and securely connect to various enterprise services.

items.original: Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 設定精靈預設啟用，自動整合 AWS 登入方式
title.en: Amazon Bedrock setup wizard enabled by default to integrate AWS login methods

body.zh-TW: 初次在工具中設定雲端模型提供者時，複雜的認證流程常讓人無所適從。⟦好比智慧電視初次開機的引導流程，以前要自己翻出網路線與遙控器代碼手動輸入，現在一開機就自動跳出連線精靈，還會把同品牌的登入選項整合在同一個畫面。⟧現在 Amazon Bedrock 的設定引導精靈改為預設開啟。當系統偵測到環境中的憑證時，API 金鑰輸入選項會自動與其他 AWS 登入方式歸類在同一個區塊，讓你清楚檢視並選取合適的登入途徑，不必再四處尋找設定入口。
body.en: When configuring a cloud model provider in the tool for the first time, complex authentication flows can feel overwhelming. ⟦Consider the initial setup guide of a smart TV, where you once had to find Ethernet cables and enter remote codes manually, but now a setup wizard appears automatically and brings brand login options together on one screen.⟧ The configuration setup wizard for Amazon Bedrock is now enabled by default. When credentials are detected in the environment, the API key input option is automatically grouped into the same section alongside other AWS login methods. This allows you to clearly view and select the appropriate sign-in path without searching around for configuration menus.

items.original: The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮失敗自動備援，恢復工作階段完整保留討論串設定
title.en: Compaction failures fall back smoothly while resumed sessions preserve thread settings

body.zh-TW: 長時間與 AI 討論累積了大量對話紀錄時，背後的摘要壓縮機制是維持流暢對答的關鍵。⟦就像編輯長篇文件時的自動存檔機制，以前存檔失敗會在草稿夾留下一半的殘缺摘要，重開檔案時個人偏好也被重設成原廠設定；現在即使背景壓縮失敗也會平穩備援，重新開啟時還能精準還原原本的排版。⟧現在對話歷史壓縮（compaction）若不幸失敗，不會再於對話紀錄中留下半截殘缺的摘要內容，背景壓縮失敗時也會安全備援而不引發程式異常崩潰。恢復工作階段（session）時，工具現在能確實找到已壓縮的歷史紀錄，並完整復原原本討論串儲存的設定，而不是擅自將它們覆蓋成全域預設值。
body.en: When extensive discussions with AI accumulate substantial conversation history, the underlying summary compaction mechanism is essential for maintaining smooth exchanges. ⟦Like an autosave feature while editing a long document, where a save failure once left a broken half-summary in drafts and reset personal preferences to factory defaults upon reopening, background compaction failures now fall back smoothly and restore original layouts upon relaunch.⟧ If conversation history compaction fails, it no longer leaves partial summary fragments in transcripts, and background compaction failures now fall back safely without triggering crashes. When resuming a session, the tool reliably finds compacted history and fully restores the thread's saved settings instead of overwriting them with global defaults.

items.original:
Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)

title.zh-TW: 自動清理未使用的安裝與市集暫存，設定日誌上限釋放磁碟空間
title.en: Prune unused installs and marketplace caches while capping daemon logs to free disk space

body.zh-TW: 工具在背景持續運作或頻繁下載外掛後，磁碟空間常常在不知不覺間被暫存檔案佔滿。⟦類似手機定期執行儲存空間大掃除，以前沒在用的舊版本與未再使用的檔案包會一直堆在角落，背景服務的紀錄簿也無限膨脹；現在清理工具會主動清空廢棄包裝，並替紀錄簿設下頁數上限。⟧現在工具加入了多項磁碟維護機制來降低空間佔用。系統會主動修剪不再使用的安裝版本，清理市集中已棄置的 checkout（取出的檔案副本）。同時替常駐程式（daemon）的日誌檔案設定大小上限，防止日誌無限制增長消耗硬碟空間。
body.en: When tools run continuously in the background or download plugins frequently, disk space often fills up unnoticed with temporary files. ⟦Similar to periodic storage cleanups on a smartphone, where unused old versions and abandoned package archives once piled up in corners while background logs grew without bound, cleanup tools now purge obsolete packages and cap log pages.⟧ The tool now includes several disk maintenance mechanisms to reduce disk usage. The system actively prunes unused installation versions and cleans up abandoned marketplace checkouts (extracted working copies of files). It also sets a size limit on daemon log files to prevent logs from growing indefinitely and consuming disk storage.

items.original: Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)

title.zh-TW: 強化執行環境安全防護，遮蔽終端機憑證並嚴格檢驗路徑
title.en: Harden runtime security by masking terminal credentials and strictly validating paths

body.zh-TW:
在執行腳本或調用系統環境時，防止敏感資訊外洩與防堵潛在執行漏洞是保障系統安全的核心關鍵。

終端機操作方面，支援的遠端 Bash 指令與 Zsh 快照工作階段（session）現在會自動遮蔽各類憑證，包含來自自訂提供者的敏感認證金鑰，避免機密在紀錄或螢幕輸出中曝光。

沙盒防護也有所強化，針對 macOS 系統上大小寫變形的中繼資料路徑，以及用來尋找執行檔的符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），都加入了嚴格的檢驗機制，防止路徑被惡意替換。

內嵌的 JavaScript 執行環境也完成更新，為最佳化後的 `Array.sort` 排序操作加入安全檢查，防範異常。以前在遠端執行或排查腳本時容易擔心金鑰外洩或路徑被掉包，現在各個執行環節都有專門的安全防線把關。
body.en:
When executing scripts or invoking system environments, preventing sensitive information leaks and closing potential execution vulnerabilities are essential to securing the system.

For terminal operations, supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions now automatically mask various credentials, including sensitive authentication keys from custom providers, preventing secrets from being exposed in logs or screen output.

Sandbox defenses have also been strengthened by adding strict validation mechanisms against case-variant metadata paths on macOS and symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location) used to locate executables, preventing paths from being maliciously substituted.

The embedded JavaScript runtime has also been updated to add safety checks to optimized `Array.sort` operations, guarding against anomalies. While running or debugging scripts remotely once raised concerns about leaked keys or swapped paths, dedicated security safeguards now protect each execution stage.

items.original:
Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)
Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援代理伺服器驗證，指令列設定覆寫與排隊流程修復
title.en: Windows supports proxy authentication alongside fixes for CLI config overrides and prompt queuing

body.zh-TW:
在企業網路環境或複雜的指令列流程中，連線驗證與參數傳遞的正確性直接影響工作進展。

在 Windows 系統中，HTTPS 與 WebSocket 連線現在能正確處理代理伺服器（proxy）的驗證要求，自動使用已登入使用者的 Negotiate 或 NTLM 憑證完成身分查核，避免連線失敗中斷。

在終端機執行多層子指令時，若在不同層級重複帶入 `-c` 或 `--config` 參數，現在各層級的設定覆寫值都會完整保留，不再被意外覆蓋或遺失。

排隊等待執行的提示詞也調整了執行邏輯，現在會確實等候前方擱置中的權限確認選單完成選擇，才會繼續往下執行。以前遇到內網代理或連續提問時容易卡在連線中斷或權限錯亂，現在整套指令與排程流程都能順暢運行。
body.en:
In enterprise network environments or complex command-line workflows, the reliability of connection authentication and parameter passing directly impacts work progress.

On Windows, HTTPS and WebSocket connections now properly handle proxy authentication challenges by automatically verifying identities with the logged-in user's Negotiate or NTLM credentials, preventing connection failures.

When running nested subcommands in the terminal with `-c` or `--config` arguments repeated across different levels, configuration overrides at each tier are now fully preserved instead of being accidentally overwritten or lost.

Queued prompts have also received updated execution logic, now reliably waiting for preceding pending permission menus to finish their selection before continuing execution. While corporate proxies or consecutive prompts once led to dropped connections or permission mix-ups, the entire command and scheduling pipeline now runs smoothly.

items.original:
Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)

entries: Added a `Configure MCP servers...` row for installed plugins in `/plugin`, so you can set or change a plugin's MCP server variables at any time without disabling and re-enabling it; plugins with missing values show `⚠ needs setup`, each server shows `✓ configured` or the variables it still needs, and saving restarts an enabled plugin's servers so the new values take effect.

Improved terminal sandbox defaults to protect more credentials: sandboxed commands can no longer read or modify `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` unless you grant access explicitly. Previously `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` were writable inside the sandbox, so sandboxed commands that use Docker registry or Kubernetes cluster credentials now need an explicit grant.
Improved context compaction, including `/compact`, to keep images, PDFs, and other files you attached in the conversation summary, so the agent can still see them after older history is summarized.

Improved permission prompts so that allowing an action for the conversation, in the main agent or in a subagent, applies across the main conversation and all of its subagents instead of asking again for the same action.

Improved the in-progress status line to show what the agent is waiting on, such as initializing MCP servers or retrying an unavailable model (for example `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` with a live countdown), instead of a generic working label.
Improved `/diff` to highlight the exact words that changed within each modified line, in every color scheme.

Improved `agy plugin validate`: it now has `--help`, checks a plugin's context providers (missing `label` or `command`, invalid or duplicate triggers, unknown fields, missing command files), warns about `skills` entries in `plugin.json` that don't exist or contain no `SKILL.md`, and reports every `SKILL.md` the plugin loader skips, including skills listed through `plugin.json` or `skills.json`.
Fixed terminal commands occasionally failing to start with `argument list too long` when the model returned a very large reasoning signature with the tool call.

Fixed text cursors drifting away from the insertion point after wide characters (CJK, emoji), tabs, other Unicode spaces, and on soft-wrapped lines, including `Up`/`Down` landing on the wrong row, in the prompt and in the settings, permission amend, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, and artifact search boxes.
Fixed the `Esc disabled during file edits` warning naming the wrong reject key when the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode.
Fixed sign-in not persisting across restarts on macOS and Windows for enterprise accounts, because the saved credential exceeded the system keychain's size limit.

title.zh-TW: 外掛清單新增 MCP 伺服器設定列，不必停用再啟用即可改變數
title.en: Plugin List Adds MCP Server Configuration Row, Updating Variables Without Disabling and Re-enabling

body.zh-TW: 平時替終端機安裝各種外掛後，若想微調連線金鑰或伺服器參數，現在不必再先停用、再重新啟用外掛。輸入 `/plugin` 檢視已安裝的外掛清單，現在每一筆外掛底下都會出現 `Configure MCP servers...` 設定選項。⟦彷彿在舞台音響架旁微調效果器的獨立旋鈕，以前更換參數就得拔掉總電源重新開機；現在面板清楚標出哪些線路仍待調整，轉完旋鈕後新設定立刻接手生效。⟧若外掛還有未填寫的變數，清單會標示 `⚠ needs setup` 提醒補齊；每個伺服器也會標出狀態，已備妥的會顯示 `✓ configured`，尚未完成的則列出具體缺少的變數名稱。儲存後，已啟用的外掛會自動重啟對應的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，讓新數值立即生效。
body.en: When fine-tuning connection keys or server parameters after installing plugins in your terminal, there is no longer a need to disable and re-enable them. Entering `/plugin` to view the list of installed plugins now displays a `Configure MCP servers...` option beneath every entry. ⟦Picture tweaking an individual knob on a stage audio rack, where changing parameters once required pulling the main power plug to restart the entire system; now the panel clearly marks which lines still need adjustment, and after turning the knob, new settings take effect immediately.⟧ If a plugin still has empty variables, the list marks them with `⚠ needs setup` as a reminder to fill them in; each server shows `✓ configured` for ready ones and lists specific missing variable names for incomplete ones. After saving, enabled plugins automatically restart their corresponding MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) servers to apply new values immediately.

items.original: Added a `Configure MCP servers...` row for installed plugins in `/plugin`, so you can set or change a plugin's MCP server variables at any time without disabling and re-enabling it; plugins with missing values show `⚠ needs setup`, each server shows `✓ configured` or the variables it still needs, and saving restarts an enabled plugin's servers so the new values take effect.

title.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒預設保護更多憑證，存取 Docker 與 Kubernetes 需明確授權
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Protects More Credentials by Default, Requiring Explicit Authorization for Docker and Kubernetes Access

body.zh-TW: 在沙盒環境執行各類指令時，本機存放的敏感憑證現在有了更嚴格的預設隔離防護。沙盒指令預設不再允許讀取或修改 `~/.docker`、`~/.kube` 與 `~/_netrc` 這三處路徑，除非你明確授權放行。⟦跟入住出租套房的生活規範一樣，以前抽屜裡的私人證件預設敞開任人翻動；現在重要暗格直接上鎖，除非屋主親自授權放行，否則誰也不能隨意翻看。⟧過去沙盒內部預設開放寫入 `~/.docker` 與 `~/.kube`，因此現在任何需要使用 Docker registry（存放容器映像檔的倉庫）或 Kubernetes 叢集憑證的沙盒指令，都必須先取得你的明確授權才能繼續執行。
body.en: When running commands inside sandbox environments, locally stored sensitive credentials now receive stricter default isolation safeguards. Sandboxed commands no longer allow reading or modifying `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` by default unless you grant explicit authorization. ⟦Much like living rules in a rented studio, private documents inside drawers were previously left open for anyone to rummage through; now important compartments are locked directly, and no one may browse them without the owner's explicit permission.⟧ In the past, sandbox environments permitted writes to `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` by default. Consequently, any sandboxed command requiring Docker registry (a repository storing container images) credentials or Kubernetes cluster credentials must now obtain your explicit authorization before proceeding.

items.original: Improved terminal sandbox defaults to protect more credentials: sandboxed commands can no longer read or modify `~/.docker`, `~/.kube`, or `~/_netrc` unless you grant access explicitly. Previously `~/.docker` and `~/.kube` were writable inside the sandbox, so sandboxed commands that use Docker registry or Kubernetes cluster credentials now need an explicit grant.

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮保留上傳圖片與 PDF，精簡歷史不漏看附件
title.en: Conversation Compaction Preserves Uploaded Images and PDFs, Keeping Attachments Accessible After History Pruning

body.zh-TW: 面對累積了大量訊息的長對話，手動或自動執行對話壓縮時，不用再擔心先前上傳的檔案就此消失。現在無論是系統自動觸發歷史壓縮，或是你在終端機手動輸入 `/compact`，對話摘要都會完整保留你先前上傳的圖片、PDF 與各類附件檔案。⟦翻閱裝訂成冊的案件卷宗，以前把過往紀錄濃縮成大綱時，夾在中間的現場照片與附件常被一併收進封存箱；現在所有參考文件都會直接釘在摘要首頁，回顧時隨時都能對照細節。⟧這讓 AI 即使在舊對話被精簡整合之後，依然能清楚讀取這些附加檔案，繼續針對檔案內的細節回答問題。
body.en: When facing long conversations with accumulated messages, you no longer need to worry about previously uploaded files disappearing during manual or automatic conversation compaction. Whether the system automatically triggers history compaction or you manually enter `/compact` in the terminal, the conversation summary completely preserves your previously uploaded images, PDFs, and various attachment files. ⟦Leafing through a bound case file where past records were condensed into outlines, crime scene photos and attachments clipped inside once got tucked away into storage boxes; now all reference documents remain pinned directly to the front page of the summary, ready for checking details at any review.⟧ This ensures the AI can still clearly inspect these attached files and continue answering questions regarding details within them, even after older exchanges are condensed and consolidated.

items.original: Improved context compaction, including `/compact`, to keep images, PDFs, and other files you attached in the conversation summary, so the agent can still see them after older history is summarized.

title.zh-TW: 授權範圍涵蓋主對話與子代理，同項操作不必重複確認
title.en: Authorization Scope Extends Across Main Conversation and Subagents, Eliminating Repeated Confirmations for the Same Operation

body.zh-TW: 把複雜任務交給子代理（在背景協助分工的獨立 AI 助理）分頭處理時，頻繁跳出的授權確認常打斷工作節奏。現在選擇針對整個對話允許這項操作後，無論你是在主對話還是子代理的授權提示中做出選擇，這項權限都會直接套用到整個主對話與旗下所有子代理。⟦持同一張專案通行證進出實驗大樓，以前只要換了不同助理人員進場操作，門禁警衛就得把主管叫出來重新簽核；現在只要主專案獲准通行，旗下所有支援團隊都能共用這項授權直接開工。⟧這省去了子代理遇到相同操作時再次請你確認的麻煩，分工作業不再頻繁中斷。
body.en: When delegating complex tasks to subagents (independent AI assistants helping divide work in the background), frequent authorization prompts often interrupt your workflow. Now, after choosing to allow an operation for the entire conversation, that permission applies directly across the entire main conversation and all of its subagents, regardless of whether you approved it from the main thread or a subagent's prompt. ⟦Holding a single project pass to access a research facility, bringing in a new assistant previously required security guards to call a manager for fresh sign-offs; now once the main project clears access, all supporting teams share that authorization to begin work immediately.⟧ This saves you from repeated approval prompts when subagents perform the same operation, keeping distributed work uninterrupted.

items.original: Improved permission prompts so that allowing an action for the conversation, in the main agent or in a subagent, applies across the main conversation and all of its subagents instead of asking again for the same action.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列顯示具體等待進度，模型重試附帶動態倒數
title.en: Status Line Displays Specific Waiting Progress with Dynamic Countdown for Model Retries

body.zh-TW: 送出複雜任務等待回應時，終端機不再只丟給你一個模糊的處理中標籤。終端機底部的 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）現在會具體列出 AI 當下正在等待的環節，取代過去籠統的運作標籤。例如它正在初始化 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，或是遇到模型暫時無法使用而自動重試時，都能即時掌握當前狀態。遇到重試狀況時，狀態列會直接出現類似 `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` 的動態倒數秒數與嘗試次數。⟦看著候機室的電子告示牌，以前遇到班機延誤只顯示含糊的處理中，讓人只能盯著螢幕乾等；現在看板會即時標明正在調度登機門，並附上精確的倒數時間。⟧
body.en: When submitting complex tasks and waiting for responses, the terminal no longer leaves you with a vague in-progress label. The status line (the status bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) now specifically lists the exact step the AI is waiting on, replacing previous generic activity indicators. Whether it is initializing an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server or automatically retrying when a model is temporarily unavailable, you can monitor current status in real time. During retry scenarios, the status line directly shows a dynamic countdown in seconds alongside the attempt count, such as `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s`. ⟦Flight display boards in an airport departure lounge once showed only a vague processing notice during flight delays, leaving passengers to stare helplessly at screens; now the board clearly states that a gate is being scheduled alongside an exact countdown.⟧

items.original: Improved the in-progress status line to show what the agent is waiting on, such as initializing MCP servers or retrying an unavailable model (for example `Model unavailable (attempt 2/10), retrying in 12s` with a live countdown), instead of a generic working label.

title.zh-TW: `/diff` 逐字突顯行內修改差異，各配色主題皆能清楚辨識
title.en: `/diff` Highlights Word-Level Inline Changes with Clear Visibility Across All Color Themes

body.zh-TW: 想看清程式碼或文字修改前後究竟動了哪幾個字，比對畫面現在能精準指出變更核心。只要在終端機輸入 `/diff` 查看修改差異，在所有色彩配置主題下，畫面都會直接在變動的那一行當中，標出真正發生變更的字詞。⟦拿螢光筆校對合約草稿時，圈出實際替換的字詞，就能把目光集中到修改的位置；現在的比對畫面也會替你標出這些重點，讓你查看每個修改行內究竟換了哪些字詞。⟧
body.en: When you want to see exactly which words were altered before and after code or text modifications, the diff view now pinpoints the core of every change with precision. Simply entering `/diff` in the terminal to inspect modifications highlights the exact words that changed right within the modified line across all color themes. ⟦Using a highlighter to proofread contract drafts, circling replaced words once helped focus attention on actual modifications; now the diff view flags those focal points for you so you can inspect exactly which words were swapped within each modified line.⟧

items.original: Improved `/diff` to highlight the exact words that changed within each modified line, in every color scheme.

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證支援說明選單，全面檢驗設定結構與技能檔
title.en: Plugin Validation Adds Help Flag, Thoroughly Verifying Config Structures and Skill Files

body.zh-TW:
開發自訂外掛時若想排查設定檔結構是否合法，現在有了更詳盡的驗證工具。在終端機執行外掛驗證指令，現在支援 `--help` 查看說明參數，並針對各項設定進行完整檢驗：

```bash
agy plugin validate --help
```

它會檢查情境提供者（context providers）的設定細節，抓出缺少 `label` 或 `command`、觸發字詞無效或重複、未知欄位，以及執行指令檔遺失等問題。針對技能設定，若 `plugin.json` 裡宣告的 `skills` 項目不存在或缺少 `SKILL.md`，驗證工具會主動發出警告，並詳細回報載入器跳過的所有 `SKILL.md`，包含透過 `plugin.json` 或 `skills.json` 引入的技能檔案。⟦檢查即將出廠的組裝模型盒，以前只粗略核對外盒印製的零件總數；現在檢驗員逐一對照說明書，抓出缺漏的組裝步驟與對不上的零件，連跳過未裝的模組都詳細列出。⟧
body.en:
When troubleshooting configuration file structures while developing custom plugins, more detailed validation tooling is now available. Running the plugin validation command in the terminal now supports `--help` to inspect parameter documentation and performs comprehensive verification across settings:

```bash
agy plugin validate --help
```

It inspects configuration details for context providers, catching missing `label` or `command` entries, invalid or duplicate trigger words, unknown fields, and missing executable script files. For skill configuration, if a `skills` entry declared in `plugin.json` does not exist or lacks `SKILL.md`, the validation tool issues a warning and reports in detail all `SKILL.md` files skipped by the loader, including skill files brought in via `plugin.json` or `skills.json`. ⟦A factory inspector examining a boxed model kit once only checked the total part count printed on the packaging; now the inspector cross-checks the instruction manual step by step to catch missing assembly steps and mismatched components, listing even the unmounted modules that were skipped.⟧

items.original: Improved `agy plugin validate`: it now has `--help`, checks a plugin's context providers (missing `label` or `command`, invalid or duplicate triggers, unknown fields, missing command files), warns about `skills` entries in `plugin.json` that don't exist or contain no `SKILL.md`, and reports every `SKILL.md` the plugin loader skips, including skills listed through `plugin.json` or `skills.json`.

title.zh-TW: 終端機游標修正全形字與換行偏誤，上下方向鍵精準對位
title.en: Terminal Cursor Resolves Offsets for Full-Width Characters and Line Wraps, Aligning Up and Down Arrow Keys Accurately

body.zh-TW: 打字輸入中文、日文、韓文或表情符號時，終端機游標現在能精準停在插入點。以前在指令提示列，以及設定、權限修改、外掛設定、意見回饋、掛鉤與成品搜尋框中，輸入中日韓全形字（CJK）、表情符號、定位字元、特殊空白或文字遇到自動換行時，游標常會偏離插入點，按上下方向鍵也會跳到錯誤的行數。這個問題已經修好，游標與方向鍵現在都能正確停在對應文字位置。
body.en: When typing Chinese, Japanese, Korean, or emoji, the terminal cursor now stays accurately positioned at the insertion point. Previously, entering full-width CJK (Chinese, Japanese, and Korean) characters, emoji, tab characters, special whitespace, or wrapped text in the command prompt, as well as in the settings, permission amendment, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, or artifact search boxes, often caused the cursor to drift from the insertion point and made up and down arrow keys jump to the wrong line. This issue has been resolved, and both the cursor and arrow keys now land on the correct text positions.

items.original: Fixed text cursors drifting away from the insertion point after wide characters (CJK, emoji), tabs, other Unicode spaces, and on soft-wrapped lines, including `Up`/`Down` landing on the wrong row, in the prompt and in the settings, permission amend, plugin setup, feedback, hooks, and artifact search boxes.

title.zh-TW: 指令啟動、檔案編輯提示與企業登入的三項異常修復
title.en: Three Fixes for Command Execution, File Edit Prompts, and Enterprise Login Issues

body.zh-TW:
平時呼叫工具跑指令、想退回工作區外的變更，或是重新啟動後準備上工時，你可能曾碰過莫名報錯或被迫重新登入。

工具呼叫附帶很大的 reasoning signature（推論簽章，模型隨工具呼叫回傳的資料）時，指令以前偶爾無法啟動並回報 `argument list too long`；這個問題已修好。

提示畫面多出一個選項時，例如在接受編輯模式（accept-edits mode）下修改工作區外的檔案，警告標語 `Esc disabled during file edits` 先前會寫錯拒絕鍵的名稱，現在會寫出正確的拒絕鍵。

macOS 與 Windows 上的企業帳號先前若因登入憑證超出系統鑰匙圈的大小上限，重新啟動後登入狀態便會失效；這個問題已經修好，登入狀態現在能在重新啟動後正常延續。
body.en:
When calling tools to execute commands, reverting changes outside your workspace, or preparing to work after a restart, you might have occasionally encountered unexpected errors or forced re-logins.

When tool calls included a large reasoning signature (data returned by models alongside tool calls), commands occasionally failed to launch with `argument list too long`; this issue has been resolved.

When the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode, the warning banner `Esc disabled during file edits` previously named the wrong reject key; it now names the correct one.

When enterprise accounts on macOS and Windows had login credentials exceeding the system keychain size limit, their login state was previously lost upon restarting; this issue has been resolved, and login status now persists properly across restarts.

items.original:
Fixed terminal commands occasionally failing to start with `argument list too long` when the model returned a very large reasoning signature with the tool call.
Fixed the `Esc disabled during file edits` warning naming the wrong reject key when the prompt shows an extra choice, such as for edits outside the workspace in accept-edits mode.
Fixed sign-in not persisting across restarts on macOS and Windows for enterprise accounts, because the saved credential exceeded the system keychain's size limit.

entries: Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success
Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`
Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer
CLI commands such as `grok models`, `grok sessions` and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early, such as when piped to `head`, or when the output device is full
`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式等待背景工作接續對話，逾時中斷改回傳錯誤
title.en: Headless mode waits for background follow-up turns and exits with error on timeout

body.zh-TW: 當你寫腳本透過指令列自動處理任務時，最怕背景工作還沒做完程式就提早離場。使用 `grok -p` 啟動無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）時，若已完成的背景工作觸發了接續對話，現在會耐心等待該輪對話結束後才退出。⟦如同自助洗衣機的運轉流程，以前主行程一結束就立刻切斷電源，不管追加的防皺運轉跑完了沒有；現在機器會等接續動作徹底收尾才關機，要是設定的時間上限強行中斷了未完工項，面板更會亮起錯誤紅燈而不是回報順利完成。⟧如果加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數且因逾時停止了待處理工作，程式結束時會回傳錯誤代碼，不再誤報為成功執行。
body.en: When scripting automated tasks through the command line, the biggest risk is a process exiting prematurely before background work finishes. When launching headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal screen) with `grok -p`, if completed background tasks trigger follow-up conversation turns, the runner now waits patiently for that turn to conclude before exiting. ⟦Like the cycle of a laundromat washing machine, the power previously cut off the moment the main cycle finished, regardless of whether the extra anti-wrinkle cycle had completed; now the machine shuts down only after follow-up actions wrap up completely, and if a configured time limit forcibly stops unfinished work, the panel flashes a red error light instead of reporting a successful run.⟧ If you provide the `--background-wait-timeout` option and pending work is stopped due to a timeout, the program now exits with an error code instead of falsely reporting success.

items.original: Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success

title.zh-TW: 儀表板冷啟動恢復工作階段，保持浮層開啟並支援按鍵返回
title.en: Dashboard cold boot resumes sessions while keeping popover open with keyboard back navigation

body.zh-TW: 你在儀表板翻找過去的歷史紀錄時，可能會想先點進某個舊存檔看看進度。在儀表板浮層中針對未預載的存檔執行冷啟動 `/resume` 時，介面現在會讓浮動面板保持附著開啟。⟦彷彿在電子導覽機前點選歷史路徑，以前只要觸控未預載的深層檔案，選單面板就會冷不防關閉脫離，讓人想反悔返回都無從按起；現在清單畫面會持續固定在視野中，隨時都能按上一頁安全退回。⟧如此一來，載入舊工作階段時不會丟失操作畫面，你可以隨時按下向左方向鍵（Left）或 `Ctrl+\` 順利退出，返回原本的清單繼續瀏覽。
body.en: When browsing past history in the dashboard, you might want to open an older saved state to inspect its progress. Triggering a cold `/resume` on an unloaded session from the dashboard popover now keeps the floating panel open and attached. ⟦At a digital directory kiosk, tapping an unloaded deep record previously caused the menu panel to snap shut and detach unexpectedly, leaving no way to step back; now the list display stays anchored in view so you can safely return at any moment.⟧ This way, you never lose your context when loading an older session, and you can press the Left arrow key (Left) or `Ctrl+\` at any time to exit cleanly and return to the list.

items.original: Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`

title.zh-TW: 選取帶參數斜線指令按 Enter 直接執行，不再殘留空格
title.en: Selecting slash commands with arguments and pressing Enter executes immediately without trailing spaces

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入框使用斜線指令時，大家常會透過選單挑選想跑的動作。當你在提示詞撰寫區反白選取帶有可選參數的斜線指令並按下 Enter 鍵時，現在會立刻執行該指令。以前輸入框（composer，撰寫提示詞的文字區）只會在指令後面留下一格多餘的空格，停在原地等待你再次確認。⟦好比在車載導航螢幕上選取附帶途經點的路線，以前按下確認鈕，畫面只會在輸入欄末端留下一格空白等候；現在一按便直接開始指引，不再卡在輸入框等待多餘的操作。⟧這樣不必在選好指令後還得手動多敲一次鍵，命令一選定就能順暢送出。
body.en: When using slash commands in the terminal input box, users often pick actions from the menu. Selecting a slash command with optional arguments in the prompt area and pressing Enter now executes that command immediately. Previously, the composer (the text area for writing prompts) only appended an extra space after the command, sitting idle while waiting for your confirmation. ⟦On an in-car navigation screen, selecting a route with waypoints and hitting confirm previously only left a blank space at the end of the input field; now a single press starts guidance immediately instead of stalling for redundant input.⟧ You no longer need to press an extra key manually after choosing a command, allowing selected actions to submit smoothly.

items.original: Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer

title.zh-TW: 多項 CLI 指令支援管道提早關閉與串流限制，避免輸出異常崩潰
title.en: Multiple CLI commands handle early pipe closures and stream limits without crashing

body.zh-TW: 平時在終端機串接多道指令過濾資料時，下游工具提早結束往往會引發非預期的中斷。包含 `grok models`、列出工作階段的 `grok sessions` 與 `grok export` 等指令，當輸出管道提早關閉（例如串接 `head` 只取前幾行）或輸出裝置已滿時，現在都不再發生當機。⟦就像工廠輸送帶上的分裝包裝線，以前只要下游集貨箱裝滿或接收閘門提早關閉，傳送機械便會當場卡死並引發整條產線警報；現在機台一旦察覺出口無法收件，就會平順停止輸出並安穩關機。⟧`grok update` 與 `grok login` 兩項指令在標準輸出（stdout）或標準錯誤關閉且無法寫入時，現在同樣能安全結束，確保批次腳本不再因串流截斷而崩潰。
body.en: When piping multiple commands in the terminal to filter data, a downstream tool exiting early often triggers unexpected disruptions. Commands including `grok models`, `grok sessions` for listing sessions, and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early (such as when piped into `head` for the first few lines) or when the output device fills up. ⟦In a factory conveyor packaging line, if a downstream collection bin filled up or a receiving gate closed early, the transport machinery previously jammed on the spot and triggered plant-wide alarms; now the equipment halts output smoothly and shuts down safely as soon as it detects that the exit cannot accept packages.⟧ `grok update` and `grok login` now also exit safely when standard output (stdout) or standard error is closed and unwritable, ensuring batch scripts no longer crash due to truncated streams.

`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

title.zh-TW: 內建 `web3d` skill，幫你做單檔 3D 網頁和瀏覽器小遊戲
title.en: Built-in `web3d` skill builds single-file 3D web pages and browser games

body.zh-TW: 想做一個能在瀏覽器裡轉動的 3D 產品展示頁，或一款小遊戲，現在可以直接交給 Muse。內建的 `web3d` skill（教 AI 照固定步驟做某類工作的說明書）會引導它做出單檔的 3D 網頁或瀏覽器遊戲，交件前先開瀏覽器檢查。動工前，它會先規劃每個部分的形狀、周遭環境和材質；第一版能跑之後，再派一個全新的測試子代理實際玩一遍、寫下批評，批評沒處理完不准交件，審查輪數也有時間上限。⟦餐廳出菜前先請另一位廚師試吃挑毛病，挑出的問題改完才端上桌，但試吃不會無限輪下去。⟧你說「停」，或只要它打開頁面時，它會立刻停止檢查。
body.en: Want a 3D product page you can spin in the browser, or a small game? You can now hand it straight to Muse. The built-in `web3d` skill (a playbook that teaches the AI fixed steps for one kind of job) guides it in building single-file 3D web pages and browser games and checking them in a browser before handoff. Before building, it plans each part's shape, surroundings and materials; after the first working build, a fresh tester subagent plays the page and writes a critique that must be closed before delivery, with a time guard on review rounds. ⟦A kitchen has a second chef taste each dish and point out flaws before it goes out, but the tasting does not go on forever.⟧ When you say stop, or just ask it to open the page, it stops checking right away.

body.zh-TW: 手上有幾張參考圖，想做出長得一樣的 3D 模型或遊戲畫面？新的 `/game-3d-visuals` 指令會依參考圖和一份視覺規格驅動 3D 模型與遊戲製作，並反覆比對渲染圖（電腦算出來的成品畫面）和參考圖，直到合格。`/blender` 則擴大到 Blender 裡的一般 3D 工作：建模、照一張圖重建場景、動畫和大型環境都能做，附帶的輔助腳本在 Blender 4 和 5 都能用。它也能拿渲染圖跟參考圖對量，逐格檢查動畫有沒有突然跳動、物體下沉或跑出鏡頭。折射的反彈次數也保留得更多，疊在一起的玻璃不會再渲染得那麼暗。
body.en: Have a few reference images and want a 3D model or game scene that matches them? The new `/game-3d-visuals` command drives 3D models and games from reference images and a visual spec, comparing each render (the finished image the computer calculates) against the references until it passes. `/blender` now covers general 3D work in Blender: object modeling, recreating a scene from an image, animation and large environments, with helper scripts that work on Blender 4 and 5. It can also measure a render against its reference image and check animations frame by frame for pops, sinking and objects leaving the shot. It keeps more refraction bounces too, so stacked glass renders less dark.

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定新增 `session/leave`，可把對話交給另一台主機
title.en: The session protocol adds `session/leave` to hand a session to another host

body.zh-TW: 自己寫用戶端、透過工作階段協定（讓其他程式操控 Muse 對話的溝通規則）接 Muse 的開發者，現在多了 `session/leave`。用戶端可以把一個已載入的工作階段交給另一台主機，原本這台主機和上面其他工作階段照常運作。⟦客服把一通電話轉給另一個部門，自己這條線和其他來電都不受影響，跟這個動作一模一樣。⟧另一個修正也跟搬動工作階段有關：主機把閒置的分支卸載後，或主機重新啟動後，用同一個指令重試 `session/fork`，以前會回內部錯誤，現在會拿回那個分支和它的歷史紀錄。
body.en: Developers who write their own clients on top of the session protocol (the rules other programs use to drive Muse conversations) now get `session/leave`. A client can hand one loaded session to another host while this host and its other sessions keep running. ⟦A support agent transfers one call to another department while their own line and every other caller carry on untouched.⟧ A related fix: retrying `session/fork` with the same command after the host unloaded the idle fork, or after a host restart, used to return an internal error; it now returns that fork and its history.

items.original:
